history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V48 scored row and publication decision. It selects the explicit managed-frame lifecycle profile and re-pins the collector and shared runner after their versioned accounting changes. Historical manifests and lifecycle v1 data remain immutable. Later integration, workload, metric or publication changes require a new version.
change: Version managed-frame lifecycle finalizers and strict legacy telemetry replay, and update the exact-parent collector and shared native runner pins. This is a contract and provenance update; it publishes no new timing or throughput evidence.

exact_parent_integration.publication_boundary: V49 preserves every inherited scored workload, job count, checksum, timing boundary, process classification, allocation replay, and publication gate. It versions managed-frame finalizer accounting as lifecycle schema v2 and updates only the affected collector and shared runner identities. Historical v1 lifecycle artifacts retain their exact schema and reconciliation; no performance improvement is claimed by this contract update.
